                Fantasy Football Trade Value Chart 2025

                Updated on Fri, 12 Sep 2025
                Trade Value Charts Explained

                These trade value charts are based on our traditional 3D values. These valuations are built on our award-winning 3D Rest of Season projections. Meaning they take into account ceilings and floors. Based on that exact league setup and scoring, these projections are put through a cross-positional algorithm to correct player values. The results are an unparalleled single value used for in-season ranking and trade valuations.

                These values update in real-time when any player's projections are adjusted, not once a week, when a writer makes some off-the cuff-adjustments.

                Ready to make a trade? Become a DS insider TODAY to access our Trade Navigator and league-sync features! Trading is hard. Let’s work through them together.
